about: The 8 prompt shapes of the setup note, section 4 (docs/notes/how-a-prompt-becomes-an-ad.md), for the scene splitter (strategy plan phase 2, D31). Each case: the story, the chosen length (null = Auto), and what the splitter and the mock writer must produce. Later phases add their checks to the same cases.

cases.story: guy wearing my hoodie in the rain

expect.later: phase 3: the slot filler marks every gap it fills as the AI's guess

cases.story:
Style: moody, rainy city at night, neon reflections, handheld phone feel.

A young man in the black City Harmony hoodie waits at a tram stop, hood up, rain dripping from the edge.

He steps under a shop awning, pulls the hood down and shakes the rain off with a grin.

He turns so the back print catches the neon light and walks off into the rain.

expect.later: phase 3: the AI marks the first paragraph as notes and the other three as scenes

cases.story:
Moody night, light rain, neon colours, one connected take.

Scene 1: he walks out of a concert, hood up. Scene 2: he stops under a neon sign and pulls the hood down. Scene 3: he smiles at the camera as the rain stops.

cases.story:
Rainy night, handheld, 26 mm phone lens. Keep the same man and hoodie in every shot.
0:00 - 0:03 (Hook): low-angle shot follows him across a wet zebra crossing.
0:03 - 0:07 (Detail): he lifts his hands into the rain, neon on the wet fabric.
0:07 - 0:10 (Close): slow push-in on the back print.

0:00 - 0:02: he opens the door.
0:02 - 0:04: he steps into the rain.
0:04 - 0:06: he pulls the hood up.
0:06 - 0:08: he crosses the street.
0:08 - 0:10: he stops at the corner.
0:10 - 0:12: he looks back at the camera.
0:12 - 0:14: he smiles and walks on.
